headline: Sayeed Khokon would visit Baridhara house, shown arrested in July murder case

members.title: Former Dhaka South mayor Sayeed Khokon arrested in Baridhara
members.lead: The Special Response Battalion (SRB) has arrested Mohammad Sayeed Khokon, former Dhaka South City Corporation (DSCC) mayor and a leader of the Awami League, whose activities are currently banned in the country. However, it was not immediately known in which case he had been arrested. SRB-1 arrested Sayeed Khokon from the capital’s Baridhara area at around 7:00 am today, Tuesday. .Former army officer Abdul Hafiz arrested. He was later handed over to the Detective Branch (DB) of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP). Shafiqul Islam, additional commissioner of the DMP’s Detective Branch, confirmed the information to Prothom Alo. Shafiqul Islam further said SRB has handed Sayeed Khokon over to them. He faces several cases, including cases related to the anti-discrimination student movement. He has been shown arrested in one of those cases, Shafiqul Islam added.

members.title: Sayeed Khokon would visit Baridhara house, shown arrested in July murder case
members.lead: Former Dhaka South City Corporation (DSCC) mayor Mohammad Sayeed Khokon has been shown arrested in a murder case filed over the anti-discrimination student movement. Deputy Commissioner (Media and Public Relations) of Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) Akhtar Hossain told Prothom Alo this on Tuesday afternoon. He said Khokon had been shown arrested in a murder case filed with Dhanmondi police station over the July uprising. He will be produced before a court. However, Akhtar Hossain could not provide further details. Sayeed Khokon visited the house in Baridhara over the past three to four months, but did not live there regularly. The Detective Branch (DB) had also tried to arrest him earlier. . Earlier, at around 7:00am, the Special Response Battalion (SRB) detained Sayeed Khokon from a house in Baridhara in the capital. The SRB later handed him over to the DB. Additional DB Commissioner Shafiqul Islam confirmed the arrest. According to DB sources, acting on a tip-off, a team of SRB-01 arrested him early in the morning from House 13 on Road 9 in Baridhara. He was subsequently handed over to the DB. DB sources said around 30 cases had been filed against Sayeed Khokon. Of these, 21 were related to the anti-discrimination student movement. He also faces several cases involving allegations of acquiring illegal wealth and money laundering. Mohammad Sayeed Khokon is a former member of parliament for Dhaka-6 constituency. He was the first mayor of the DSCC. He is the son of Mohammad Hanif, the former mayor of undivided Dhaka City.
